h: The Divine Beauty Revealed Through an Awakened Heart

p: "May He send us His beauty," etc.
The matter of the "beauty" of Hashem Yisbarach, as it were,
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (קֹהֶלֶת ח, א)
"A man's wisdom lights up his face."
"Great is the power of the prophets,
who liken the form to its Former," etc.:
"'A likeness as the appearance of a man
for the creation of the world
He emanated in the likeness of man,
in the order of the stature of man.
"Is he a teacher and drunk?" etc.;
"rather, 'A man's wisdom lights up his face.'"
וְכֵן בַּיְרוּשַׁלְמִי (פֶּרֶק ג דִּשְׁקָלִים הֲלָכָה ג)
And so in the Yerushalmi (Shekalim, chapter 3, halachah 3):
"A man's wisdom lights up his face."
as it were, with Hashem Yisbarach;
as is found in the holy Zohar, Yisro:
the head of Zeir Anpin is filled
And the dew of Atika Kadisha
הַיְינוּ בְּחִינַת אוֹר תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
is the aspect of the light of Torah she'b'al peh,
with which He will in the future revive the dead,
And when there enters from the dew of Atika,
which is the crownlet of the yud,
and from there it shines to Zeir Anpin,
from this "the face" of Zeir Anpin
and this is "May He send us His beauty."
And Rabbi Yisrael Saruk, of blessed memory,
in his commentary on the zemiros of the Arizal,
and afterward he brings the reading "shofar."
and its Aramaic is shufra, with an alef.
And what connection does a shofar have here?
עַל פִּי דְּאִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג רסא, א)
according to what is found in the holy Zohar (III 261a):
'And the likeness of Hashem he beholds.'
the upper heh, the lower heh;
קוֹל גָּדוֹל וְלֹא יָסָף (דְּבָרִים ה, יט) וְכוּלֵּי
'a great voice that did not cease' (Devarim 5:19)," etc.
And at Matan Torah it is written (Shemos 20:15):
"And all the people see the voices."
וּלְפִי מַה שֶּׁאָמַר בַּגְּמָרָא (בְּרָכוֹת ו, ב)
And according to what the Gemara says (Berachos 6b)
that his forefathers did not stand
for this remains in Yisrael forever,
And this is the meaning of
And at Matan Torah it is written (ibid. 19:16):
"And the sound of the shofar was very strong";
that is, similar to what it says (Yeshayahu 27:13):
"And it will be on that day:
a great shofar will be sounded,
and those lost in the land of Ashur will come."
That is, an awakening will come into the heart
so that they will be aroused,
even "those lost in the land of Ashur,"
who have assimilated among the nations,
And this was so then as well,
at the time of Matan Torah,
even though they had been sunk in Egypt.
what does it matter to us
whether it is large or small?
Rather, this is the supernal shofar," etc.,
"and that is called the great shofar."
And it is implied in the holy Zohar
that when there is the awakening from Binah,
which is the sound of the shofar in the heart,
"and the likeness of Hashem he beholds";
for when it enters the depths of the heart,
as if plain to the eye;
וְכָל זֶה אֵינֶנּוּ שֹׁוֶה לִי וְגוֹמֵר
"Yet all this is worth nothing to me," etc.:
that all the treasures of that wicked man
so that then one can say "this,"
as if pointing with a finger.
וְזֶה שִׂמְחָתוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
And this is the joy of HaKadosh Baruch Hu,
"It does not say 'Hashem rejoiced in His works,'
עָתִיד הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לִשְׂמוֹחַ וְכוּלֵּי
HaKadosh Baruch Hu is destined to rejoice," etc.
"A joyful heart makes a good cure."
And this is what we request,
meaning, that there be an awakening
into the heart of every Jew;
and as a result of this
there will be joy to Hashem Yisbarach,
and "a joyful heart makes a good cure";
for the one depends on the other.
"And my heart has seen much wisdom."
"And may He show us His hidden things":
that is, the aspect of Chochmah and Binah,
as is found in Pesach Eliyahu:
וְעַל אִילֵּין תְּרֵין כְּתִיב (דְּבָרִים כט, כח)
"And about these two it is written (Devarim 29:28):
'The hidden things belong to Hashem our God.'"
that Hashem Yisbarach show us this.

paragraphs.text: Source: Esther 5:13 — “וכל זה איננו שוה לי בכל עת אשר אני ראה את מרדכי היהודי יושב בשער המלך” — “Yet all this means nothing to me every time I see that Jew Mordecai sitting in the palace gate.””

paragraphs.text: Source: Koheles 1:16 — “דברתי אני עם לבי לאמר אני הנה הגדלתי והוספתי חכמה על כל אשר היה לפני עלירושל͏ם ולבי ראה הרבה חכמה ודעת” — “I said to myself: “Here I have grown richer and wiser than any who ruled before me over Jerusalem, and my mind has zealously absorbed wisdom and learning.””

paragraphs.text: Source: Devarim 29:28 — “הנסתרת ליהוה אלהינו והנגלת לנו ולבנינו עד עולם לעשות את כל דברי התורה הזאת” — “Concealed acts concern the ETERNAL our God; but with overt acts, it is for us and our children ever to apply all the provisions of this Teaching.”
